edition_note: Paragraph numbers are from the MPLADS Guidelines (June 2016), the latest edition we could read (T001 will check the 2023 wording). Every threshold comes from guidelines_clauses.yaml.
grading_note: T051: a rule broken by a little and a rule broken by a lot must not score the same. R01 grows from 0.30 just past the clock to its severity (0.60) at four times the clock; R02 from 0.15 at one year to 0.30 at the type's 98th percentile, then to 0.60 at twice that (log scale). One delay alone can still never make a work High.

terms.note: Lok Sabha terms that have ended (Delay & Fund Flow engine, T410). A work recommended under an ended term and still not sanctioned is money of a dissolved House waiting. Rajya Sabha members' terms are individual and not in the export, so they are not modelled.

17th Lok Sabha.source: 17th Lok Sabha dissolved by the President on 5 June 2024

split_limits.note: Amounts pile up just under these sums nationally (12.1x more works just under Rs 5 lakh than just over, 11.5x at Rs 10 lakh; data/trial/split_trial.py). A group whose every piece sits within 80-100% of one while the total passes it is read as possibly kept under a limit (Duplicate & Split engine).

election_pauses.note: Model code of conduct periods left out of the sanction clock, as para 3.12 says. Add each Lok Sabha general election (and, when the data says which works are affected, state assembly elections) as the Election Commission announces it. The engine says when a work's waiting time runs past the last date this list was checked.

periods.name: 2024 Lok Sabha general election
periods.source: Election Commission of India press notes, 16 March and 6 June 2024

rules.title: Waiting for sanction past the time limit
rules.condition: status is RECOMMENDED and days since recommendation, less days under the 2024 general-election model code of conduct, exceed 75
rules.message_en: Waiting {days} days for sanction, {over} days past the {limit}-day limit ({ref}) and {times} times the time allowed. Needs checking with the district office.
rules.message_hi: स्वीकृति की प्रतीक्षा {days} दिनों से, {limit} दिन की सीमा ({ref}) से {over} दिन अधिक (अनुमत समय का {times} गुना)। ज़िला कार्यालय से जाँच आवश्यक।

rules.title: Open far longer than similar works
rules.condition: status is SANCTIONED and days since recommendation exceed the 98th percentile completion time of its work type (LOW when only past the one-year norm)
rules.message_en: Still open {days} days after recommendation: {over} days beyond the {limit} days by which 98% of completed {type} works had finished. Needs a progress check.
rules.message_hi: अनुशंसा के {days} दिन बाद भी अधूरा: पूरे हुए {type} कार्यों में 98% जिस अवधि ({limit} दिन) में पूरे हुए, उससे {over} दिन अधिक। प्रगति की जाँच आवश्यक।
rules.low_message_en: Open {days} days after recommendation, {over} days past the one-year norm ({ref}); 98% of completed {type} works finished within {p98}. The guidelines allow longer when the sanction letter records why.
rules.low_message_hi: अनुशंसा के {days} दिन बाद भी अधूरा, एक वर्ष की सामान्य अवधि ({ref}) से {over} दिन अधिक; पूरे हुए {type} कार्यों में 98% {p98} में पूरे हुए। स्वीकृति पत्र में कारण दर्ज हो तो अधिक समय मान्य है।

rules.title: Spent more than sanctioned
rules.needs: expenditure per work (not in the public export; utilisation certificates carry it for some works - task T103)
rules.message_en: Spent {spent} against a sanction of {sanctioned}. Needs checking.
rules.message_hi: {sanctioned} की स्वीकृति के विरुद्ध {spent} खर्च। जाँच आवश्यक।

rules.title: Marked complete with nothing spent
rules.needs: expenditure per work (not in the public export)
rules.message_en: Marked complete but no expenditure is recorded. Needs checking.
rules.message_hi: पूर्ण दर्ज है पर कोई खर्च दर्ज नहीं। जाँच आवश्यक।

rules.title: Most money released, work not started
rules.needs: expenditure and physical progress per work (not in the public export)
rules.condition: expenditure >= 90% of sanction and progress = not started
rules.message_en: {share} of the sanction is spent but the work is recorded as not started. Needs a site check.
rules.message_hi: स्वीकृत राशि का {share} खर्च, पर कार्य शुरू नहीं दर्ज। स्थल जाँच आवश्यक।

rules.title: Dates in an impossible order
rules.condition: completed 7+ days before recommended, in a quarter where this is not a bulk-entry artefact (LOW when it is); or a completion date after the data was published (LOW)

rules.title: May be a work the guidelines do not allow
rules.condition: the description reads as an Annexure-II item being the work itself (Eligibility v2 reader, 56% precision measured on a fresh sample)
rules.message_en: The description reads as "{keyword}" being the work itself; Annexure-II item {item} lists this as not permitted ({text}). Verify against the 2023 guidelines before any action.
rules.message_hi: विवरण से लगता है कि कार्य स्वयं "{keyword}" है; परिशिष्ट-II मद {item} इसे अनुमति नहीं देता। कोई कार्रवाई से पहले 2023 दिशानिर्देशों से सत्यापन करें।

rules.title: Outside the constituency, above the ceiling
rules.condition: work outside the MP's constituency with an amount above Rs 25 lakh
rules.message_en: A work outside the constituency is capped at {limit} a year ({ref}); this one is {amount}. Needs checking.
rules.message_hi: निर्वाचन क्षेत्र से बाहर के कार्य की सीमा {limit} प्रति वर्ष है ({ref}); यह कार्य {amount} का है। जाँच आवश्यक।

rules.title: No progress for six months
rules.needs: dated progress updates per work (not in the public export)
rules.condition: no progress update for 180 days on an open work
rules.message_en: No progress recorded for {days} days. Needs a progress check.
rules.message_hi: {days} दिनों से कोई प्रगति दर्ज नहीं। प्रगति जाँच आवश्यक।

rules.title: SC/ST area share below the earmark
rules.needs: an SC/ST-area tag per work (not in the public export); judged per MP-year, never used to score an MP
rules.condition: share of an MP-year's money in SC areas < 15% or ST areas < 7.5%
rules.message_en: SC/ST area share below the earmark for this MP-year.
rules.message_hi: इस सांसद-वर्ष में अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति क्षेत्र का हिस्सा निर्धारित से कम।

rules.title: Key details missing from the record
rules.condition: no amount, no work type, no recommendation date, or a description that does not say what is built or bought
rules.message_en: The record is missing {missing}, so parts of it cannot be checked.
rules.message_hi: रिकॉर्ड में {missing_hi} नहीं है, इसलिए इसके कुछ हिस्सों की जाँच नहीं हो सकती।

rules.title: Big sanction that does not say what or where
rules.condition: Rs 10 lakh or more, above the top (p90) of its work type nationally, and a description of at most six words with no number (count, length, plot) and no place name. Replaces the Odd Overall engine (T053): 30 of 30 read by eye as a question the record cannot answer.
rules.message_en: {amount} for "{text}": the record does not say where, or how much is built or bought, so the work cannot be checked or inspected. Most {type} works cost up to {top}. Ask for the site and the size.
rules.message_hi: "{text}" के लिए {amount}: रिकॉर्ड में न स्थान है, न यह कि कितना बनाया या खरीदा गया, इसलिए कार्य की जाँच या निरीक्षण नहीं हो सकता। स्थान और मात्रा माँगें।

rules.title: Construction recorded complete within days
rules.condition: a building, road, drain, pond or similar of Rs 5 lakh or more recorded complete 0-14 days after recommendation, outside a bulk-entry quarter, and not a backfilled older work. Replaces the Odd Overall engine (T053): 13 of 13 read by eye as dates that cannot be right.
rules.message_en: {amount} {type} work recorded complete {days} days after it was recommended ({rec} to {done}); a construction of this size cannot be finished that fast. Check the completion certificate and the dates.
rules.message_hi: {amount} का {type} कार्य अनुशंसा के {days} दिन बाद ({rec} से {done}) पूर्ण दर्ज है; इस आकार का निर्माण इतनी जल्दी पूरा नहीं हो सकता। पूर्णता प्रमाणपत्र और तिथियों की जाँच करें।
